name: artifact-notifier
description: Real-time artifact version notifier (npm/Maven/PyPI) with OIDC auth and email notifications

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
